sky cinema comedy.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
sky cinema comedy.desc: A grant-greedy principal puts two clueless teens in a bogus class for students with special needs.

sky cinema comedy.title: Team America: World Police
sky cinema comedy.desc: A gung-ho, `Thunderbirds'-style squad of puppets lead America's war on terrorism. The creators of `South Park' go on the offensive with an outrageous animated satire that makes a target of everyone from politicians to Hollywood liberals.

sky cinema comedy.title: Bridesmaids
sky cinema comedy.desc: Though broke and lovelorn, a woman takes on the strange and expensive rituals associated with being her best friend's maid of honour.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema comedy.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Innerspace
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A scientifically miniaturised marine unexpectedly finds himself floating around the body of a hypochondriac, and trying to outwit saboteurs who want the device that shrank him. Attempts by his colleagues to retrieve the little man - protected inside a tiny submersible - are hampered by the would-be thieves.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Constantine
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Supernatural tale based on the cult comic book `Hellblazer'. Chain-smoking loner Constantine tries to buy his place in heaven by banishing earth-bound demons back to hell, but his fate is tied up with Angela, a policewoman investigating the alleged suicide of her twin.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to launch an assassination attempt on President Snow.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Green Lantern
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A test pilot is granted a mystical green ring that bestows him with otherworldly powers, as well as membership into an intergalactic squadron tasked with keeping peace within the universe. Based on DC Comics characters.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Waterworld
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

sky cinema thriller.title: Nightcrawler
sky cinema thriller.desc: A driven young man named Lou stumbles upon the underground world of Los Angeles freelance crime journalism.

sky cinema thriller.title: Icefall
sky cinema thriller.desc: A young Native American game warden captures a notorious poacher only to learn that the poacher is aware of the location of a plane carrying millions of dollars that has crashed in a frozen lake.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
sky cinema thriller.desc: Former CIA assassin Jason Bourne continues his quest to fill in memory gaps. When a `Guardian' reporter stumbles onto his trail, Bourne spies his chance to blow the Blackbriar black-ops brigade wide open. With some very powerful people intent on keeping their skeletons buried, he is in more danger than ever before, as his former paymasters send a series of elite killers after their reformed ex-colleague.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Accountant
sky cinema thriller.desc: A mild mannered, socially weird government accountant moonlights as a highly trained, and deadly assassin.

sky cinema thriller.title: Mr & Mrs Smith
sky cinema thriller.desc: John and Jane Smith are a typical suburban couple first seen undergoing marriage counselling to try and get the spark back in their relationship. What neither of them knows is that the other is a highly skilled assassin until, separately, they get a call for their next job. Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.

sky cinema greats.title: Caddyshack
sky cinema greats.desc: A rich property developer wants to take over an exclusive country club and so challenges its pompous president to a game of golf leading to utter mayhem, and a stream of surreal and crude visual gags.

sky cinema greats.title: Clear and Present Danger
sky cinema greats.desc: Investigating the assassination of a friend of the President, CIA agent Ryan discovers that his friend was in league with the Colombian drugs cartels. In revenge, a paramilitary force is sent in to wipe out the drug lords but when the operation goes wrong, they're abandoned by their country. Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema greats.title: Full Metal Jacket
sky cinema greats.desc: A US Marine observes the effects the Vietnam War has on his fellow Marines from their brutal basic training to the bloody street fighting in Hue, Vietnam.

sky cinema greats.title: The Big Heat
sky cinema greats.desc: An honest policeman is determined to bust police corruption and the stranglehold of the Mafia. At first he innocently begins investigating the Mafia-related killing of a fellow officer, but things turn nasty when his wife is killed in a car bomb blast meant for him, his child is threatened with kidnapping and he loses his job.

sky cinema greats.title: Dirty Harry
sky cinema greats.desc: A violent and uncompromising police officer hunts for a psychopath who holds the city of San Francisco to ransom. Although the officer's unorthodox methods do not endear him to his superiors, the mayor reluctantly agrees that Harry Callahan seems to be the right cop for the job.

Now their only hope is Ryan and fellow renegade operative Clark.

sky cinema drama.desc: While widow Aurora fends off a stream of admirers, daughter Emma learns the hard facts of married life.

sky cinema drama.title: I, Tonya
sky cinema drama.desc: In 1991, talented figure skater Tonya Harding becomes the first American woman to complete a triple axel during a competition. In 1994, her world comes crashing down when her ex-husband conspires to injure Nancy Kerrigan, a fellow Olympic hopeful, in a poorly conceived attack that forces the young woman to withdraw from the national championship. Harding's life and legacy instantly become tarnished as she's forever associated with one of the most infamous scandals in sports history.

sky cinema drama.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
sky cinema drama.desc: A single father and his young son endure many hardships as the father struggles to provide a better future for both of them.

sky cinema drama.title: Grease
sky cinema drama.desc: High-spirited musical set in 1950s America, in which a girl and boy who met on the beach are unexpectedly reunited at high school. She cannot understand how different he has become. Can the leather-clad, tough-talking leader of the T-Birds really be the same person? Perhaps her new friends, the Pink Ladies, can help her win back his heart?

sky cinema drama.title: Song Sung Blue
sky cinema drama.desc: Two down-on-their-luck performers form a Neil Diamond tribute band, proving it's never too late to find love and follow your dreams.
